newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian Prime Minister Karim al-Kabariti and Saudi industry minister are to open the first Saudi industry exhibition in Jordan.
- The United States proposed three steps to overcome the crisis between Palestinians and Israel.
- Kuwaiti court cancels rulings passed against suspects who were accused of fraud at the Kuwait Oil Tanker Company.
- Gulf Arab states need $50 billion to increase their oil production capacity.
- Iran proposed a cooperation committee with Saudi Arabia.
- Absence of Arab coordination encouraged Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to ignore commitments towards Middle East peace, Syrian vice-president says.
